title: CompletionsExtension

sessionId.description: The session to continue; a fresh session when absent. The answer carries the session's id.

anyOf.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

permissionMode.description: The mode the turn asks for: clamped to the client session's ceiling, and the clamp reported as agent-harness.clamped on the first chunk; the unattended default when absent.

anyOf.description: What an agent may do without asking during a run, in the order ceilings use: plan < acceptEdits < auto < bypassPermissions. Claude's default and dontAsk are never used.

systemPrompt.description: Text appended after the environment's composed instructions, never replacing them; at most 200,000 characters.

alwaysOnSkills.description: Accepted and reported as ignored on the first chunk until the skill set (ticket 89) honours it.

forkSession.description: Run the turn on a fork of sessionId rather than on sessionId itself.

rewindToMessageId.description: Rewind sessionId to this user message before the turn runs.

anyOf.description: A user message's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when a client sends it, and the id the provider is handed.

attachments.description: Images or files sent with the trailing user message.

kind.description: What an attachment is: an image (the adapter needs imageInput) or a file (fileInput).

data.description: Its bytes, in standard padded base64, at most 20971520 bytes decoded (the maxLength bounds it within two bytes; the environment checks the decoded size); the log never holds them.

items.description: An attachment as a client sends it: kind, name, media type and its bytes in base64.

thinking.description: The reasoning effort; the top-level reasoning_effort is its alias.

workspace.description: A directory the environment has, for a fresh session: an absolute path, or one from its home (~); one it cannot use is refused 400 with its problem. With none the session gets a scratch workspace of its own.

attended.description: A person is present to answer prompts: they park until a client answers. False when absent: the unattended rule answers them.

browser.description: The browser a session the turn makes (a fresh one, or a fork) has: headless, the environment's headless browser; none when absent, since a program brings its own tools. Any other value is refused 400. Reported ignored on a turn that makes no session.

after.description: On a session whose run is live, the log sequence to attach from: the events of the run after it are sent first.

anyOf.description: A position in the event log's global sequence; 0 is the cursor before the first event.

ignoreUnsupported.description: Ignore, and report, the OpenAI parameters the surface would otherwise refuse with 400.

description: The harness's fields on a completions request, under agent-harness.
